translation:
In the condition of injury with thirst (作渴), if it is due to excessive loss of blood, use Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) with added ginseng (人參) and atractylodes (白朮); if there is no response, use ginseng (人參) and astragalus (黃耆) to supplement qi, and dang gui (當歸) and cooked rehmannia (熟地) to supplement blood, or use Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯). If stomach heat injures the fluids (津液), use Bamboo Leaf and Astragalus Decoction (竹葉黃耆湯). If the stomach is deficient and the fluids are insufficient, use Supplementing the Middle and Benefiting Qi Decoction (補中益氣湯). If stomach fire is blazing, use Bamboo Leaf and Gypsum Decoction (竹葉石膏湯). If there is vexing heat with thirst and dribbling and painful urination, this is deficiency heat of the kidney channel, and without the Rehmannia Pill (地黃丸) it cannot be saved. <ins>Bamboo Leaf and Astragalus Decoction (竹葉黃耆湯)</ins>
Light bamboo leaf (淡竹葉, two qian), ginseng (人參), astragalus (黃耆), raw rehmannia (生地黃), dang gui (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), ophiopogon (麥冬), peony (芍藥), licorice (甘草), gypsum (石膏, calcined), scutellaria (黃芩, stir-fried), pinellia (半夏, each one qian)
Decoct in water and take.
